title: Detailed pancakes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M38 30 Q35 25 38 20' stroke='#c8d8f0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <path d='M62 30 Q59 25 62 20' stroke='#c8d8f0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
